name: Mori no Kai
description: A quiet, editorial theme for forest-conservation nonprofits, land trusts and community woodland groups, laid out like a walk under old cedars: generous whitespace, light Newsreader titles with an italic second voice, an asymmetric grid with a narrow margin rail for field-note labels, large misty photographs that settle slowly into place and hairline rules; with restoration projects, a year-in-the-forest calendar, volunteer work days with a sign-up form and FAQ, explanatory giving tiers with where the money goes (no payment taken), a one-page impact report with numbers and accounts, the people, news, a seasonal newsletter and contact, in moss, cedar bark, morning mist and sumi ink, plus a night-forest dark variation.

fonts.role: titles, leads, numbers and the wordmark
body text, navigation, buttons and forms
